    How was this little day chosen?

    We match your interests and visit budget, then favor indoor options in wetter or colder weather and woodland shade in heat. Wind, darkness and concerning forecast conditions lower outdoor recommendations. Every stop keeps its original suggested visit length. We reserve 20 minutes within a park area and 40 minutes when changing areas. These are editorial planning allowances, not measured walking times; actual travel may take longer. This is not a walking route, booking service or opening-hours check. The Muny stays in the guide, but is excluded from automatic plans because performances need a confirmed schedule.

      03 / Before you wander

      A few field notes.

      An independent guide to real places.
      A little preparation makes room for a lovely day.

      Are these real places?

      Yes. All fourteen are in Forest Park, St. Louis. Location notes are curated from Forest Park Forever and its official park guide. The illustrations are artistic interpretations.

      Does the page need my location?

      No. Weather is requested for Forest Park’s fixed coordinates, never your device location. The fourteen places are curated; no map or place-search requests are needed.

      Are the suggested times walking directions?

      No. They are suggested time to spend at each stop, chosen for this guide. Your list is not an optimized route and does not include walking time between places.

      Are the places open right now?

      This is not a live availability service. Weather, repairs, events, and seasonal conditions can affect access. Check the official park notices before visiting. The Jewel Box interior may have separate hours and admission.

      What should I bring?

      Water, comfortable shoes, and layers are a good start. A book or picnic blanket is optional. Stay on designated paths, leave wildlife undisturbed, and take everything you brought back home.

      Will my field notes stay here?

      Your selected places are saved in this browser when local storage is available. Download a text copy to keep them elsewhere. Clearing browser data removes your saved list.
